name: fan-cards
title: Fan Cards
description: Fan out the deck and lift the card under your pointer.
useCases: In an illustrator’s portfolio, a visitor fans out labeled cards to see which works belong to a series.
In a card-game demo, a player fans out their hand and moves the pointer across it to lift an individual card.
task: Fan out the deck and lift the card under your pointer.
behavior: cards contains labels in display order. The component manages the open fan state.
